meeting.type: Strategic and Budget Planning Retreat (St. George)
meeting.summary: Two-day retreat at the Hilton Garden Inn in St. George. Council immediately entered closed session, then reconvened for substantive work on the Strategic Vision, Mission, and Values; revenue generation; the budget; Council-initiated priorities; governmental authority; economic-development direction; and review/purge of the Legislative Priorities List. Mayor Gray also briefed Council on Unified Fire Authority and Unified Fire Service Authority context.
